source.title: Night City 2045
source.note: Direct source review of all six Port of Night City rows the v0.2 audit classified CONTEXT_ONLY. Civic and B2B operations are separated from residential and internal-security context. Factual metadata and concise paraphrases only; source prose is not reproduced.

entities.name: Dock Cargo Community
entities.source_summary: Small cargo-container residential community between working docks; no customer-facing commerce is described.

entities.name: Harbor Patrol HQ
entities.source_summary: Thelas Marines headquarters with internal maintenance, medical, training, accommodation and vehicle facilities; no public customer service is established.

entities.name: Main Port
entities.source_summary: Continuous cargo-handling port with multiple operating quays and a dry dock that has already taken an outside vessel for repair.

services.label: Commercial cargo transfer and quay handling

entities.name: Mestnyy Bank
entities.source_summary: Consortium-operated community bank offering loans on stated reasonable terms, with criminal leverage rumored around its record-keeping.

entities.name: Reclaimed Studios
entities.source_summary: Occupied studio-apartment building near Medical Technologies; the source establishes housing but does not describe a public rental or other customer-facing operation.

entities.name: The Reclamation Plant
entities.source_summary: Working water-reclamation plant that processes wastewater and sells treated solid waste primarily to Biotechnica; the city Department of Water also operates from the site.

local_offerings.label: Processed solid waste sold primarily to Biotechnica

entities.name: Night City Department of Water
entities.source_summary: City water department operation based at the Reclamation Plant, sending field crews to install and repair plumbing and sewer infrastructure around Night City.

services.label: City plumbing and sewer installation and repair
